file_roles.evidence: logDeleteDirName now truncates the topic prefix so the whole name stays <=255 chars (`prefixLength = Math.min(topic.size, 255 - suffix.size)`); before, the -delete name could exceed the limit.
alterReplicaLogDirs gets a new check throwing InvalidTopicException when logFutureDirName(...).size > 255, rejecting the request instead of fixing name generation.

rationale: The rename failure surfaces in LogManager.asyncDelete, but the too-long directory name is produced by Log.logDeleteDirName, which is corrected. ReplicaManager adds a validation for the similar future-dir case, which stops a related failure without fixing name generation.
